chunks: I have been sent as a trusted messenger to you.
ai.seo_question: What does the title 'Rasool Ameen' signify in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's (SAWW) *ismah* (infallibility) and trustworthiness (*amin*) as a divine guarantee of the message's purity. It serves as a foundational proof for the authority of the Imams, who inherit this same quality of reliability as successors to the Prophet. The term 'Amin' here is not merely a title but a theological attribute confirming the divine origin of the revelation.
